scheme_name: Seekho aur Kamao (Learn & Earn) for Minorities
overview: Seekho aur Kamao (Learn & Earn) for Minorities is a skill development scheme aimed at enhancing the employability of minority youth through training in various sectors. The scheme focuses on providing placement-linked skill training to school dropouts and educated unemployed youth from notified minority communities. It is implemented through Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs) selected by the Ministry of Minority Affairs.
objectives: Enhance employability of minority youth through skill training
Provide placement-linked training in various sectors
Target school dropouts and educated unemployed youth from minority communities
Upgrade skills of minority youth in modern and traditional vocations
Ensure at least 75% placement of trained youth, with 50% in organized sector
eligibility: Youth belonging to notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains) in the age group of 14–45 years, with minimum educational qualification varying by course, and preference given to school dropouts and educated unemployed youth.
benefits: Free skill training, stipend during training, placement assistance, post-placement support, and certification upon successful completion. The scheme also provides soft skills and entrepreneurship development training.
financial_support: The scheme provides 100% funding for training costs and a stipend of Rs. 1,000 per month per trainee during the training period. Financial assistance is released to Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs) in installments based on milestones such as enrollment, training completion, and placement.
application_process: 1. Identify and mobilize eligible minority youth. 2. Enroll candidates in approved training courses through Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs). 3. Provide skill training along with stipend. 4. Conduct assessments and certification. 5. Facilitate placement of trained youth. 6. Submit claims for reimbursement to the Ministry of Minority Affairs with required documents.
required_documents: Age proof (birth certificate, school certificate, etc.)
Training center details and course information
caveats: At least 75% of trainees must be placed, with 50% in the organized sector
Training must be conducted through empaneled Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs)
Beneficiaries must belong to notified minority communities only
Stipend is payable only during the training period and is subject to attendance
